notes.title: Blog writer headings, colors and links
notes.summary: Expanded the themed visual writer with Header (H1), Heading 2-6 and Paragraph controls, a built-in custom-color picker and rainbow/common presets. Compact Structure and Style dropdowns keep formatting accessible, with direct font, strike and highlight controls. Links now separate displayed text from the destination; saving and reloading preserve formatting and existing content.

notes.title: Reviewed deployment changelog publishing
notes.summary: Added an opt-in publisher for reviewed, grouped release notes after verified deployments. A dedicated changelog-only credential protects publication, the endpoint verifies the live site revision, and an atomic release ledger prevents retries from duplicating entries. Existing changelog history and Admin drafts are preserved; version bumps remain deliberately reviewed.
